blurb: Guests can experience whitewater rafting on the Rouge River, self-guided canoeing and kayaking on the Rouge and Diable Rivers, and virtual reality arcade games including car racing and fighter pilot training. Rafting includes guided runs with safety briefings and equipment provided. Canoeing and kayaking are self-guided with shuttle transport and equipment rental.
